Here is the English translation of Verse 27 of Surah Fatir, followed by a breakdown of the key vocabulary describing the colors of the mountains:

​Quranic Verse Translation

​"Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And among the mountains are tracks of white and red of varying shades and [others] extremely black." (Surah Fatir: 27)


​Key Vocabulary Breakdown

​Judadun (جُدَدٌ): Tracks, streaks, or layers running through the mountains.

​Beedun wa Humrun (بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ): White and red (referring to the light and reddish mineral/rock strata).

​Mukhtalifun Alwanuha (مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا): Of varying colors or diverse shades.

​Gharabeebu Soodun (وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ): Intensely black or pitch-black (in Arabic, gharabeeb is used for emphasis to denote absolute, deep darkness, like dark basalt rock).
